sad.en: She felt sad when the class trip was cancelled.
sad.zh: 班級旅行取消時，她感到難過。

saddle.en: The rider checked the saddle before entering the training area.
saddle.zh: 騎手進入訓練區前檢查了馬鞍。

sail.en: Small boats sail across the bay on calm mornings.
sail.zh: 天氣平靜的早晨，小船會航行穿過海灣。

sailor.en: The sailor described life at sea during the museum talk.
sailor.zh: 水手在博物館講座中描述海上生活。

saint.en: The painting depicts a saint from a medieval story.
saint.zh: 這幅畫描繪一位中世紀故事中的聖人。

sake.en: For the sake of accuracy, check the data one more time.
sake.zh: 為了準確起見，再檢查一次資料。

salad.en: The lunch set includes soup, salad, and fresh fruit.
salad.zh: 午餐套餐包含湯、沙拉和新鮮水果。

salary.en: The article compares salary levels across several different professions.
salary.zh: 文章比較幾種不同職業的薪資水準。

sale.en: The bookstore announced a weekend sale on selected notebooks.
sale.zh: 書店宣布週末部分筆記本特價。

salesman.en: The salesman explained the product features without pressuring customers.
salesman.zh: 男銷售員在不施壓顧客的情況下說明產品功能。

salesperson.en: A salesperson helped us compare two models in the store.
salesperson.zh: 一名銷售人員在店裡幫我們比較兩種型號。

saleswoman.en: The saleswoman answered questions about the warranty and return policy.
saleswoman.zh: 女銷售員回答了保固與退貨政策的問題。

salmon.en: The biology lesson explained how salmon migrate between rivers and oceans.
salmon.zh: 生物課說明鮭魚如何在河川與海洋之間洄游。

salon.en: The old building once served as an art salon for local painters.
salon.zh: 這棟老建築曾是當地畫家的藝術沙龍。

salt.en: The experiment compared fresh water with water containing salt.
salt.zh: 實驗比較淡水和含鹽的水。

salty.en: The soup tasted too salty, so the cook adjusted the recipe.
salty.zh: 湯太鹹，因此廚師調整了食譜。

salute.en: The ceremony ended with a formal salute to the visiting guests.
salute.zh: 典禮以向來賓致意的正式敬禮作結。

salvage.en: Workers managed to salvage useful materials from the damaged building.
salvage.zh: 工作人員成功從受損建築中搶救出可用材料。

sand.en: Fine sand covered the path near the beach entrance.
sand.zh: 海灘入口附近的小徑覆蓋著細沙。

sandal.en: One sandal was left beside the swimming pool.
sandal.zh: 游泳池旁留著一隻涼鞋。

sandwich.en: He packed a sandwich and fruit for the field trip.
sandwich.zh: 他為校外教學準備了三明治和水果。

sanitation.en: The report examines sanitation conditions in rapidly growing cities.
sanitation.zh: 報告探討快速成長城市中的衛生條件。

satellite.en: The satellite sends weather data back to scientists on Earth.
satellite.zh: 衛星把氣象資料傳回地球上的科學家。

satisfaction.en: Finishing the difficult project gave the team great satisfaction.
satisfaction.zh: 完成困難的專題讓團隊很有成就感。

satisfactory.en: The first test produced a satisfactory result for the research team.
satisfactory.zh: 第一次測試為研究團隊帶來令人滿意的結果。

satisfy.en: The revised plan should satisfy the main requirements of the assignment.
satisfy.zh: 修訂後的計畫應能符合這份作業的主要要求。

sauce.en: She added a mild tomato sauce to the pasta.
sauce.zh: 她在義大利麵中加入溫和的番茄醬。

saucer.en: The cup rested on a small white saucer.
saucer.zh: 杯子放在一個白色小碟子上。

sausage.en: The breakfast plate included bread, eggs, and one sausage.
sausage.zh: 早餐盤裡有麵包、蛋和一根香腸。

saving.en: Saving a little money each month can build a useful reserve.
saving.zh: 每個月存一點錢可以累積實用的備用金。

saw.en: The museum displayed an old saw used by early carpenters.
saw.zh: 博物館展示早期木匠使用的舊鋸子。

scan.en: Please scan the document before uploading it to the class folder.
scan.zh: 請先掃描文件，再上傳到班級資料夾。

scandal.en: The newspaper reported the scandal without repeating unverified claims.
scandal.zh: 報紙報導這起醜聞時沒有重複未經證實的說法。

scarcely.en: There was scarcely enough time to finish the final question.
scarcely.zh: 幾乎沒有足夠時間完成最後一題。

scare.en: The sudden noise was enough to scare the birds away.
scare.zh: 突然的聲響足以把鳥群嚇走。

scared.en: The puppy looked scared during the loud thunderstorm.
scared.zh: 大雷雨時，那隻小狗看起來很害怕。

scarf.en: She wore a warm scarf during the cold morning commute.
scarf.zh: 寒冷的早晨通勤時，她圍著一條保暖圍巾。

scary.en: The movie looked scary, but the ending was actually funny.
scary.zh: 那部電影看起來很可怕，但結局其實很好笑。

scatter.en: Strong wind can scatter dry leaves across the playground.
scatter.zh: 強風會把乾葉吹散到操場各處。

scenario.en: The class discussed a scenario involving a sudden schedule change.
scenario.zh: 班上討論了一個突然更改行程的情境。

scene.en: The final scene takes place beside a quiet river.
scene.zh: 最後一幕發生在一條安靜的河邊。

scenery.en: The mountain scenery attracted many visitors during autumn.
scenery.zh: 秋天的山景吸引許多遊客。

scenic.en: The bus route follows a scenic road along the coast.
scenic.zh: 這條公車路線沿著景色優美的海岸道路行駛。

scent.en: A fresh citrus scent filled the room after cleaning.
scent.zh: 打掃後，房間裡充滿清新的柑橘香氣。

schedule.en: The teacher posted the revised schedule on the classroom wall.
schedule.zh: 老師把修訂後的時程貼在教室牆上。

scheme.en: The city introduced a recycling scheme for local schools.
scheme.zh: 市府為當地學校推出一項回收計畫。

scholar.en: A visiting scholar gave a lecture about ancient trade routes.
scholar.zh: 一位訪問學者舉辦了關於古代貿易路線的講座。

scholarship.en: She applied for a scholarship to support her future studies.
scholarship.zh: 她申請獎學金以支持未來的學習。

scissors.en: Use the scissors carefully when cutting the poster paper.
scissors.zh: 裁剪海報紙時請小心使用剪刀。

scold.en: The teacher chose to explain the mistake rather than scold anyone.
scold.zh: 老師選擇解釋錯誤，而不是責罵任何人。
